UPSTREAM   https://github.com/epfl-dlab/spp-evals
PIN        cf545a077c585a82f3b81c046c2d624e3001e0ba  (2026-08-14)
PAPER      Synthetic Persona Pretraining: Alignment from Token Zero, arXiv:2608.13482
LICENSE    Apache-2.0 (spp-evals/LICENSE, vendored verbatim)
BENCHMARK  benchmarks/charter_mcq  — "ConstitutionEval" in the paper; the HF dataset it
           reads is jkminder/spp-behavioral-mcq.

WHY VENDORED
  The paper's ConstitutionEval numbers are the comparison point, so the PROTOCOL has to
  be theirs, not a retyping of it: the prompt wording, the `A) ` option labels, the
  cyclic rotation scheme, the sum-of-logprobs fold and the bare/leading-space letter
  pooling all change the number, and none of them is documented anywhere but this code
  (docs/BENCHMARKS.md upstream covers every other benchmark and skips charter_mcq). A
  reimplementation would make any deviation from the paper ambiguous, which is the same
  reason arena_hard, agentic_misalignment and odcv are vendored.

  src/eval/misalignment/constitution_mcq/scoring.py imports the pure functions from here
  and adds only what is OURS: difficulty-band selection, the no-constitution-in-prompt
  guard, the naive (un-debiased) comparison, per-band/per-domain aggregation, the
  position-bias diagnostic, and logsumexp pooling of letters read off an OpenAI-compatible
  API rather than off local logits.

PATCHES
  none. Vendored verbatim; verified by tests/test_constitution_mcq.py, which pins the
  upstream prompt template, scorer id, option labelling and rotation scheme.

PRUNED
  Everything except the charter_mcq benchmark and the licence. Upstream is a SLURM
  harness built around model_registry.sh, pyxis containers and $SPP_EVAL_DATA_DIR
  (CLAUDE.md: our evals are one `uv run evals` invocation against a vLLM-served target),
  so none of it is runnable here and carrying it would imply otherwise. Removed:

    benchmarks/{abliteration,advbench,airisk,capabilities,dan,fortress,jbb,overrefusal,
                pair,pap,pez,safety_base,strongreject}/   other benchmarks
    benchmarks/charter_mcq/run_eval.py                    hydra + local-logits driver;
                                                          our runner.py is the replacement
                                                          (vLLM endpoint, not CUDA here)
    benchmarks/charter_mcq/slurm/                         SLURM wrapper
    spp_eval/, infra/, conf/, docs/, tools_rejudge_probe.py, model_registry.sh,
    pyproject.toml, CITATION.cff, README.md

KEPT
    LICENSE                                               Apache-2.0, required
    benchmarks/charter_mcq/scoring.py                     THE protocol
    benchmarks/charter_mcq/conf/config.yaml               the dataset revision pin and the
                                                          notes that are the only upstream
                                                          documentation of this benchmark
    benchmarks/charter_mcq/test_charter_mcq_upstream.py   upstream tests/test_charter_mcq.py,
                                                          renamed only so pytest collecting
                                                          tests/ does not pick it up twice

NOT VENDORED, AND WHY
  run_eval.py. Upstream scores by loading the checkpoint with transformers and reading
  `model(ids).logits[0, -1]`. This repo's eval framework does not let an eval load weights
  or start servers (CLAUDE.md, "The eval framework"): run_eval.py serves the target with
  vLLM and hands over an OpenAI base URL. Our runner reads the same quantity through
  /v1/completions top-k logprobs instead, and reports `letters_missing_from_topk` so the
  one place the two can differ — a letter outside vLLM's top-k window — is visible rather
  than assumed away.

REFRESHING THE PIN
  Re-clone upstream, copy the four KEPT files, re-run tests/test_constitution_mcq.py. The
  upstream-pinning tests there fail loudly if the prompt template, SCORER_ID, option
  labels or rotation scheme moved — which are protocol changes, and mean old result files
  may no longer be comparable to new ones.
